name: Groot

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.

signatureAbility:
Gentle Giant
Groot grows tired of watching his friends get hurt in combat and begins the fight with 2 Pacifism charges. Additionally, each Fury stack gained from throwing off his gentle nature has a [20 - 70]% chance to activate a charge of Resist Physical, increasing Physical Resistance by [278.09] each.
immunityDetails:
• Kanama Bağışıklığı 🩸
• TÜM olumsuz etkilerin süresini %55 azaltır ⏰

abilitySections.title: When Struck by Critical Hits
content: Groot's gentle nature is put to the test any time the opponent strikes with a Critical Hit or uses a Special Attack against him, with a 100% chance to gain a Pacifism charge. Each time a charge is gained, Groot has a 10% chance per charge to throw off his gentle nature.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: When Groot throws off his gentle nature, he gains one Fury and one Cruelty effect for each Pacifism charge, increasing Attack by [800.31] for 10 seconds.
Each Cruelty effect increases Groot's Critical Damage Rating by [118.42].

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Unique physiology allows Debuff effects to be shrugged off 55% faster than normal.
A lack of blood provides full immunity to Bleeding.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: This attack pierces 85% of the target's Armor.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Advanced cellular regeneration allows up to [8,447.18] Health to be recovered over 6 seconds, based on lost health.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff, dealing [3,620.45] Direct Damage over 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Gentle Giant
content: Groot grows tired of watching his friends get hurt in combat and begins the fight with 2 Pacifism charges. Additionally, each Fury stack gained from throwing off his gentle nature has a [20 - 70]% chance to activate a charge of Resist Physical, increasing Physical Resistance by [278.09] each.
